svg.aria-label: osf doctor in the osf CLI
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: osf doctor in the osf CLI
svg.desc: The new subcommand sits on the CLI surface, builds a report from six small check functions, and leans on four existing modules plus the filesystem and environment for its inputs.
